scripts.lint: pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=2 lint && eslint --cache --cache-strategy content --cache-location node_modules/.cache/eslint/root scripts .claude eslint.config.js
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm decisions check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.check:changed: pnpm format:check && pnpm decisions check && pnpm -r --filter "...[origin/main]" --filter "!{.}" --if-present lint && pnpm -r --filter "...[origin/main]" --filter "!{.}" --if-present typecheck && pnpm -r --filter "...[origin/main]" --filter "!{.}" --if-present test
